## Core Stack
- **Frontend:** React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router v7, PWA, Leaflet
- **Backend & Data:** Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, SQL / SQLite, Redis, Cloudinary
- **CMS & SEO:** PHP, WordPress, Elementor, Schema.org JSON-LD, SEO & AIEO
- **Tooling & Systems:** Vitest, Supertest, Docker, Linux, Raspberry Pi, ESP32

## Services
- **Business Websites:** Mobile-first, fast-loading websites structured for SEO and AI Engine Optimization (AIEO).
- **Custom Web Tools:** Booking portals, client dashboards, member/staff areas, and custom REST APIs tailored to business workflows.

## Primary Projects
- **[Root Studio Fitness](https://builtbymarco.dev/projects/root-studio-fitness)** (`Live` — https://www.rootstudiofitness.com): Production SEO/AIEO studio site + full-stack PWA with 4-tier RBAC (`member`, `staff`, `admin`, `super_admin`), stateful `SHA-256` `HttpOnly` cookie sessions with device-fingerprint hijack detection, live workout player, +650 exercise library, internal ticketing (`/mail`), Raspberry Pi `systemd` keepalive, JSON DB backup/restore, and 226 automated Vitest/Supertest backend tests.
- **[BuiltByMarco.dev](https://builtbymarco.dev/projects/marco-portfolio)** (`Live` — https://github.com/Marco-Martins-97/marcoPortfolio): Bilingual dark-mode developer portfolio and web development studio built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and a Stage 2 MERN-mirrored service layer.
- **[HomeLab](https://builtbymarco.dev/projects/homelab)** (`Building`): Low-power self-hosted home server on Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (DietPi, Pi-hole, FileBrowser, Nginx, Node.js, and planned ESP32 telemetry sensors).
- **[Obelisk](https://builtbymarco.dev/projects/obelisk)** (`Building` — https://obelisk.builtbymarco.dev/): Asynchronous browser MMORTS (`v0.1.0`) with a deterministic `100×100` continent & `25×25` territory engine (Mulberry32 PRNG, 2D Perlin/fBm noise, Voronoi stone provinces, BFS moisture) and interactive HTML5 Canvas Dev Sandbox.
